why: A group whose every baz is NULL, so sum(baz) is NULL and only the COALESCE default carries the column.

SumBaz#1 (quantity).note: The rule sqlc lacks: its COALESCE non-null-default reasoning does not fire through an aggregate argument. Measured on v1.31.1 — `coalesce(baz, 0)` is NOT NULL there, `coalesce(sum(baz), 0)` is nullable.
